summary: RETEST after CORS fix — verified WITHOUT the route-proxy bypass. The Expo web preview now successfully makes live authenticated /api/* calls from a real browser at https://boat-community.expo.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend (see new cors_middleware in /app/backend/server.py) returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for Bearer-only requests (no session cookie) and echoes Origin+credentials when a session cookie is present. Confirmed via curl (OPTIONS -> ACAO:*, GET /api/auth/me -> 200 ACAO:*) AND via a real Chromium session seeded with a fresh Bearer token in localStorage. Observed 0 failed /api calls. All requested mobile flows re-verified end-to-end: Feed shows 6 post-card-* + notifications-btn + new-post-fab; Events shows 21 event-card-* + 11 market-chip-* (incl market-chip-all); Directory (labelled 'Boat Pros') shows 4 pro-card-* + directory-search-input; Messages shows the 2 seeded threads and chat send worked ('RETEST cors ok' text appears in the thread after chat-send-btn — WebSocket path works); Profile renders with manage-pro-btn/newsletter-switch/logout-button; Pricing shows the Test mode banner and 9 subscribe-* buttons. Pro review submission on /directory/seed_rigging still POSTs /api/reviews successfully (200) but shows NO visible success confirmation — 'Review posted' alert is still not shown (unfixed from iteration_55). Bundle compiles; only benign RN-Web 'shadow*' deprecation warnings in the console. The primary CORS blocker from iteration_55 is RESOLVED.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py cors_middleware is a clean and correct fix for the browser/Bearer scenario: wildcard ACAO when no session cookie, credentialed origin-echo when a cookie is present. Verified with curl and a real browser. Nice.

One minor nit in cors_middleware: 'access-control-request-method' presence check is only used for preflight detection; it's fine, but conventionally you can also fast-return for OPTIONS regardless of that header to short-circuit even simpler probes.

mobile AuthContext still silently falls through to null user if /auth/me ever fails — with CORS fixed this is far less likely, but a small 'Can't reach server' banner would still make future infra faults easier to diagnose.

rca of the issue: Previous CORS block (iteration_55) is fixed by the new middleware in /app/backend/server.py (lines ~59-78): when the incoming request lacks a `session_token=` cookie (i.e. the mobile Bearer path), the response now sets `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` unconditionally, sidestepping the edge Origin-rewrite problem entirely because there is no origin echo happening. When the request DOES carry a session cookie (web), the middleware echoes Origin + Access-Control-Allow-Credentials:true. Verified: `curl -X OPTIONS -H 'Origin: https://boat-community.expo.preview.emergentagent.com' https://owsa-events-preview--7evdsk8f.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/me -D-` -> `HTTP/2 204` + `access-control-allow-origin: *`. Real-browser network log shows every /api/* response carrying ACAO:* and zero CORS errors.
